summary: Add typed thread messages and explicit ask links

replay.detail: The mixed timeline reads existing graph messages and lifecycle claims. No replay of existing data is required.

schema.detail: Add indexed lookup for thread-bearing messages and a reserved thread.ask-linked claim. Message relation fields were staged in the reader release.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. Thread delivery uses the existing graph and its retention.

compatibility.detail: Ordinary message replies preserve existing settlement semantics. Typed thread messages carry separate quote and ask relations and remain graph claims. Install the thread privacy reader release fleet-wide before enabling thread writes. The local build and every configured or active peer must support thread_read_privacy version 2.

downtime.detail: No planned service interruption. Store open builds an additive message index.

manual.detail: Set thread_writes=true at daemon startup only after verifying the live privacy build on every serving replica.

recovery.detail: Existing messages need no conversion. After enabling writes, keep all serving replicas at or above the thread privacy reader release when rolling back, restoring or joining a member.
